entries.label: killed_fwiffo
entries.body: I am afraid Fwiffo is no longer with the living.
entries.source: I am afraid Fwiffo is no longer with the living.
entries.translation: 恐怕菲弗已經不在人世了。

entries.label: POOR_FWIFFO
entries.body: Somehow, Captain, we are not surprised.
entries.source: Somehow, Captain, we are not surprised.
entries.translation: 不知怎麼的，艦長， 我們一點也不驚訝。

entries.label: fwiffo_fine
entries.body: What Fwiffo? Oh, he's fine, just great. Really! Doing swell.
entries.source: What Fwiffo? Oh, he's fine, just great. Really! Doing swell.
entries.translation: 什麼菲弗？喔，他很好， 好得不得了。真的！ 活蹦亂跳的。

entries.label: NOT_LIKELY
entries.body:
Well then, surely you would have no trouble letting Fwiffo approach the viewscreen for a little chat
would you, Captain?
We thought not.
entries.source:
Well then, surely you would have no trouble letting Fwiffo approach the viewscreen for a little chat
would you, Captain?
We thought not.
entries.translation:
那麼，讓菲弗走到螢幕前跟 我們聊幾句，想必不成問題 吧
對不對，艦長？
我們就知道。

entries.label: we_attack_again
entries.body: Our new course of action involves combat.
entries.source: Our new course of action involves combat.
entries.translation: 我們的新行動方針涉及戰 鬥。

entries.label: WE_FIGHT_AGAIN
entries.body: New? New!? This is not a new thing. Your violent ways are, as they say in your language, as old as the hats.
entries.source: New? New!? This is not a new thing. Your violent ways are, as they say in your language, as old as the hats.
entries.translation: 新？新的！？這哪裡新了。 用你們的話來說， 你們的暴力作風可是跟帽子 一樣老。

entries.label: bye_no_ally_offer
entries.body: We must go, but we shall return soon.
entries.source: We must go, but we shall return soon.
entries.translation: 我們必須走了， 但很快就會回來。

entries.label: GOODBYE_NO_ALLY_OFFER
entries.body: Please don't hurry on our account.
entries.source: Please don't hurry on our account.
entries.translation: 不必為了我們趕著回來。

entries.label: bye_angry_spathi
entries.body: I can tell you are upset, and so we shall leave.
entries.source: I can tell you are upset, and so we shall leave.
entries.translation: 我看得出你們很不高興， 所以我們這就離開。

entries.label: GOODBYE_ANGRY_SPATHI
entries.body: Suddenly we grow less upset.
entries.source: Suddenly we grow less upset.
entries.translation: 我們突然沒那麼不高興了。

entries.label: why_dont_you_do_it
entries.body: Why don't you do it?
entries.source: Why don't you do it?
entries.translation: 你們為什麼不自己去做？

entries.label: WE_WONT_BECAUSE
entries.body:
Two reasons.
Firstly, we have an unreasoning fear that the Evil Ones will devour us all painfully.
Secondly, in the rare cases where we have overcome our fear, and ventured to Spathiwa's surface
the Spathi who landed were all devoured painfully.
entries.source:
Two reasons.
Firstly, we have an unreasoning fear that the Evil Ones will devour us all painfully.
Secondly, in the rare cases where we have overcome our fear, and ventured to Spathiwa's surface
the Spathi who landed were all devoured painfully.
entries.translation:
兩個理由。
第一，我們毫無理性地害怕 邪惡者會痛苦地吃掉我們所 有人。
第二，在極少數我們克服恐 懼、冒險降落斯帕西瓦地表 的情況中
登陸的斯帕西全都被痛苦地 吃掉了。

entries.label: MEAN_GUYS_RETURN
entries.body:
Look, look everyone! It's the violent creature from Earth.
I wonder how many of our encrustlings it wants to devour today?
entries.source:
Look, look everyone! It's the violent creature from Earth.
I wonder how many of our encrustlings it wants to devour today?
entries.translation:
快看，大家快看！ 是那個來自地球的暴力生 物。
不知道它今天又想吃掉多少 個幼殼仔？

entries.label: we_apologize
entries.body: We regret our past deeds, so why dwell on the past? Let's look forward to a bright new future, together!
entries.source: We regret our past deeds, so why dwell on the past? Let's look forward to a bright new future, together!
entries.translation: 我們對過去的行為深感悔 恨，何必再沉湎於往事？ 讓我們一起迎向光明的新未 來吧！

entries.label: DONT_BELIEVE
entries.body:
I am probably just an old stick-in-the-mud, Captain, but I just can't let go of the idea
that this is all part of some devious trick of yours to torture and kill my species.
entries.source:
I am probably just an old stick-in-the-mud, Captain, but I just can't let go of the idea
that this is all part of some devious trick of yours to torture and kill my species.
entries.translation:
艦長，或許我只是個食古不 化的老頑固，但我就是無法 擺脫一個念頭
這一切都是你的奸計， 目的是折磨並殺光我的種 族。

entries.label: HELLO_AGAIN
entries.body:
We did not expect to see you again so soon, Hunam!
Our prognosticators had indicated that you would not return for at least 30 years
and now I fear, they will lose their tenure as a consequence.
How sad. I expect each had thousands of encrustlings to feed who will now go hungry.
Here's an idea! Leave now and do not return until the appointed time.
This premature visit shall remain our little secret, eh?

entries.translation:
沒想到這麼快又見到你， 胡南！
我們的預言家明明指出， 你至少要三十年後才會回來
我怕他們會因此丟掉終身 職。
真可悲。我看他們每人都有 幾千個幼殼仔要養， 現在都得挨餓了。
我有個主意！你現在離開， 等到指定時間再回來。
這次提早來訪就當作我們之 間的小祕密，好嗎？

entries.label: HATE_YOU_FOREVER
entries.body:
We, the High Ruling Council of Spathiwa have just passed a new law.
Your continued existence is now a crime!
With the authority of justice, we attack!
entries.source:
We, the High Ruling Council of Spathiwa have just passed a new law.
Your continued existence is now a crime!
With the authority of justice, we attack!
entries.translation:
我等斯帕西瓦最高統治議會 剛剛通過了一條新法律。
你繼續存在，現在已構成犯 罪！
我們以正義之權威發動攻 擊！

entries.label: WHAT_IS_PASSWORD
entries.body: What is the Secret Cypher?
entries.source: What is the Secret Cypher?
entries.translation: 祕密暗號是什麼？

entries.label: WHAT_IS_PASSWORD_AGAIN
entries.body:
We'll give you just one more chance.
What is the Cypher?
entries.source:
We'll give you just one more chance.
What is the Cypher?
entries.translation:
我們再給你最後一次機會。
暗號是什麼？

entries.label: we_are_vindicator0
entries.body: Attention aliens: I am
entries.source: Attention aliens: I am
entries.translation: 外星人注意：我是

entries.label: we_are_vindicator1
entries.body: acting Captain of the starship
entries.source: acting Captain of the starship
entries.translation: ，星艦代理艦長

entries.label: we_are_vindicator2
entries.body: . Please Respond.
entries.source: . Please Respond.
entries.translation: 。請回應。

entries.label: gort_merenga
entries.body: Uh... Gort, merenga!
entries.source: Uh... Gort, merenga!
entries.translation: 呃……Gort， merenga！

entries.label: guph_florp
entries.body: Er... florp blurt a-ruppa-tuppa?
entries.source: Er... florp blurt a-ruppa-tuppa?
entries.translation: 呃……florp blurt a-ruppa-tupp a？

entries.label: pleeese
entries.body: How about `Pleeeeeze!'
entries.source: How about `Pleeeeeze!'
entries.translation: 「求求你嘛— —！」怎麼樣？

entries.label: wagngl_fthagn
entries.body: Wagh-nagl Fthagn?
entries.source: Wagh-nagl Fthagn?
entries.translation: Wagh-nagl Fthagn？

entries.label: screw_password
entries.body: Screw this Cypher business -- can't we just talk?
entries.source: Screw this Cypher business -- can't we just talk?
entries.translation: 去他的暗號——我們就不能 直接談談嗎？

entries.label: good_password
entries.body: Huffi-Muffi-Guffi.
entries.source: Huffi-Muffi-Guffi.
entries.translation: Huffi-Muffi- Guffi。

entries.label: WRONG_PASSWORD
entries.body:
You do not know the Secret Cypher!
Therefore, you must be an evil, dangerous alien invader
intent on killing all of us in some horrible fashion!
We have every right to prevent this.
entries.source:
You do not know the Secret Cypher!
Therefore, you must be an evil, dangerous alien invader
intent on killing all of us in some horrible fashion!
We have every right to prevent this.
entries.translation:
你不知道祕密暗號！
所以你必定是邪惡又危險的 外星侵略者
一心想用某種可怕手段殺光 我們！
我們完全有權阻止你。

entries.label: NO_PASSWORD
entries.body:
You have tried to trick us with a clever deception
however, we are ever wary and have uncovered your evil scheme!
While we abhor violence, we have found that under circumstances like this
the best course of action is to attack suddenly with overwhelming force.
Like so.

entries.translation:
你試圖以狡猾的騙術欺騙我 們
然而我們時刻戒備， 已識破你的邪惡陰謀！
雖然我們深惡暴力， 但在這種情況下，我們發現
最佳行動方針就是以壓倒性 武力發動突襲。
就像這樣。

entries.label: what_do_i_get
entries.body: Once I've given you the Cypher, what do I get?
entries.source: Once I've given you the Cypher, what do I get?
entries.translation: 我說出暗號後， 能得到什麼？

entries.label: YOU_GET_TO_LIVE
entries.body: You get to live a bit longer.
entries.source: You get to live a bit longer.
entries.translation: 你可以多活一會兒。

entries.label: YES_GOOD_PASSWORD
entries.body:
We are The Safe Ones -- the Spathi High Council.
You have given us the correct Cypher and so you will not be destroyed immediately.
Now, if you please, tell us how you acquired our most Secret Spathi Cypher
which every Spathi swears never, never to reveal
even when threatened with considerable pain.
entries.source:
We are The Safe Ones -- the Spathi High Council.
You have given us the correct Cypher and so you will not be destroyed immediately.
Now, if you please, tell us how you acquired our most Secret Spathi Cypher
which every Spathi swears never, never to reveal
even when threatened with considerable pain.
entries.translation:
我們是「安全者」——斯帕 西最高議會。
你說出了正確暗號， 因此不會立刻遭到摧毀。
現在，可以請你告訴我們， 你是如何取得斯帕西最高機 密暗號的嗎
每個斯帕西都發誓永遠、 永遠不會洩漏
即使受到相當痛苦的威脅也 一樣。

entries.label: spathi_on_pluto
entries.body: We met a Spathi on Pluto... uh, we became good friends!
entries.source: We met a Spathi on Pluto... uh, we became good friends!
entries.translation: 我們在冥王星遇到一個斯帕 西……呃，我們成了好朋 友！

entries.label: WHERE_SPATHI
entries.body:
And just where is this Spathi `friend' now?
Never mind -- the answer is all too obvious in your tiny, dry eyes.
entries.source:
And just where is this Spathi `friend' now?
Never mind -- the answer is all too obvious in your tiny, dry eyes.
entries.translation:
那麼，這位斯帕西「朋友」 現在到底在哪裡？
算了——答案早已清楚寫在 你那雙又小又乾的眼睛裡。

entries.label: hostage
entries.body: We have Fwiffo on board. He can vouch for our good intentions!
entries.source: We have Fwiffo on board. He can vouch for our good intentions!
entries.translation: 菲弗就在我們船上。 他可以證明我們心懷善意！

entries.label: GUN_TO_HEAD
entries.body:
If you held a weapon to Fwiffo's head, he would say anything you wanted him to say.
In fact, if you held a vegetable to his head
he would probably say anything you wanted him to say.
entries.source:
If you held a weapon to Fwiffo's head, he would say anything you wanted him to say.
In fact, if you held a vegetable to his head
he would probably say anything you wanted him to say.
entries.translation:
如果你拿武器抵著菲弗的 頭，要他說什麼他都會說。
事實上，就算你拿一根蔬菜 抵著他的頭
他大概也會照你意思說任何 話。

entries.label: we_come_in_peace
entries.body: We come in peace, and with good will.
entries.source: We come in peace, and with good will.
entries.translation: 我們為和平而來， 並懷有善意。

entries.label: OF_COURSE
entries.body: No doubt.
entries.source: No doubt.
entries.translation: 那當然。

entries.label: KILLED_SPATHI
entries.body:
No, you ARRIVED in peace.
You CAME in a somewhat more violent manner
as indicated by this report from the Spathi patrol vessel you attacked.
entries.source:
No, you ARRIVED in peace.
You CAME in a somewhat more violent manner
as indicated by this report from the Spathi patrol vessel you attacked.
entries.translation:
不，你們抵達時很和平。
但你們來的過程就暴力多了
這份你們襲擊過的斯帕西巡 邏艇報告足以證明。

entries.label: misunderstanding
entries.body: Uh, that was just kind of a misunderstanding.
entries.source: Uh, that was just kind of a misunderstanding.
entries.translation: 呃，那只算是某種誤會。

entries.label: JUST_MISUNDERSTANDING
entries.body:
Of course Captain, we realize that misunderstandings happen... occasionally.
Let us just hope that no similar `misunderstanding' causes us to open fire on you
with our planetary defense batteries.
entries.source:
Of course Captain, we realize that misunderstandings happen... occasionally.
Let us just hope that no similar `misunderstanding' causes us to open fire on you
with our planetary defense batteries.
entries.translation:
當然，艦長，我們明白誤 會……偶爾會發生。
只希望別再有類似的「誤 會」，導致我們用
行星防禦砲台向你開火。

entries.label: give_us_resources
entries.body: As a gesture of good will, could you spare some mineral resources?
entries.source: As a gesture of good will, could you spare some mineral resources?
entries.translation: 為了展現善意， 可以分一些礦物資源給我們 嗎？

entries.label: NO_RESOURCES
entries.body: No.
entries.source: No.
entries.translation: 不行。

entries.label: resources_please
entries.body: Now that our alliance is firmly established, could you please transport large quantities of valuable minerals to our ship?
entries.source: Now that our alliance is firmly established, could you please transport large quantities of valuable minerals to our ship?
entries.translation: 既然我們的同盟關係已牢不 可破，可以請你把大量珍貴 礦物運到我們船上嗎？

entries.label: SORRY_NO_RESOURCES
entries.body: No.
entries.source: No.
entries.translation: 不行。

entries.label: bye_ally
entries.body: Goodbye Council members.
entries.source: Goodbye Council members.
entries.translation: 再見，議會成員。

entries.label: GOODBYE_ALLY
entries.body: Goodbye hunam.
entries.source: Goodbye hunam.
entries.translation: 再見，胡南。

entries.body: What can you tell me about the Ur-Quan Hierarchy?
entries.source: What can you tell me about the Ur-Quan Hierarchy?
entries.translation: 你能告訴我哪些關於烏爾關 階序的事？

entries.label: what_about_history
entries.body: What do you know about ancient history?
entries.source: What do you know about ancient history?
entries.translation: 你對遠古歷史知道多少？

entries.label: what_about_alliance
entries.body: Do you know anything about the old Alliance races?
entries.source: Do you know anything about the old Alliance races?
entries.translation: 你知道舊聯盟各種族的事 嗎？

entries.label: what_about_other
entries.body: Are you aware of any other alien cultures?
entries.source: Are you aware of any other alien cultures?
entries.translation: 你知道其他外星文化嗎？

entries.label: what_about_precursors
entries.body: Do you have any information on the Precursors?
entries.source: Do you have any information on the Precursors?
entries.translation: 你有任何關於先驅者的情報 嗎？

entries.label: enough_info
entries.body: That's enough info for now.
entries.source: That's enough info for now.
entries.translation: 目前知道這些就夠了。

entries.label: OK_ENOUGH_INFO
entries.body: Good. I don't feel much like talking about that anyway.
entries.source: Good. I don't feel much like talking about that anyway.
entries.translation: 很好。反正我也不太想談那 個。

entries.label: ABOUT_HIERARCHY
entries.body:
Since we never wanted to be in the Hierarchy, and we're afraid of all the other members
our knowledge on this subject is a bit limited, but I'll tell you what I know.
The Hierarchy is the construct of the Ur-Quan. It exists to maintain their supreme authority
over all sentient lifeforms in the galaxy.
As far as we know, there are 6 other races active in the Hierarchy, including:
the gelatinous Umgah pranksters,
the multi-legged, super-violent Ilwrath who are fanatical in their worship of Dogar and Kazon,
the Thraddash - a weak and obnoxious race from the Draconis group of stars,
the humanoid clones you call Androsynth, though they have been strangely absent for some years,
the vain VUX, commanded by the brilliant and eccentric general ZEX,
and the mysterious Mycon, who ramble endlessly about people, places and events from long ago
as though they happened just today.
If there are other Hierarchy races, we are not aware of them.

由於我們從來就不想加入階 序，又害怕其他所有成員
所以對這方面所知有限， 不過我可以把知道的告訴 你。
階序是烏爾關建立的體制。 它的存在是為了維持他們對
銀河系一切智慧生命的最高 權威。
據我們所知，階序內目前還 有六個活躍種族，包括：
膠狀、愛惡作劇的烏姆加，
多足又極端暴力的伊爾拉 斯，他們狂熱崇拜多加爾與 卡宗，
瑟拉達什——來自 Draconis 群星的一個弱小又討人厭的 種族，
你們稱作安德羅辛斯的人形 複製人，不過他們近年離奇 地銷聲匿跡，
自負的 VUX，由才華橫溢又古怪 的澤克斯將軍統領，
還有神祕的邁康， 他們會沒完沒了地談論久遠 以前的人物、地方與事件
彷彿那些事就在今天發生。
若階序還有其他種族， 我們並不知情。

entries.label: ABOUT_HISTORY
entries.body:
Before the Evil Ones appeared, we Spathi were a simple folk
we were content with our calm lives, our rude huts
and our coarse-woven turtle-neck sweaters.
I suppose we could have remained that way for eons
were it not for the sudden arrival of a million voracious monsters from hell!
We have never quite figured out where they, the Evil Ones, came from.
The few specimens we collected, who had mostly died of tooth decay from eating sweet Spathi flesh
were physiologically unlike any other species from Spathiwa.
It was as though they had arrived suddenly on the surface of our planet
transported there by some unknown agency... but that is nonsense
who could be so cruel?!

在邪惡者出現以前， 我們斯帕西是個純樸的民族
滿足於平靜生活、簡陋茅屋
以及粗織高領毛衣。
我想，我們本可這樣生活無 數世代
要不是一百萬隻來自地獄的 貪吃怪物突然出現！
我們始終無法弄清楚那些邪 惡者究竟從何而來。
我們收集到的少數樣本， 大多因吃太多甜美的斯帕西 肉而蛀牙死亡
在生理構造上與斯帕西瓦的 任何其他物種都不相同。
他們彷彿突然出現在我們行 星表面
被某個未知力量傳送到那 裡……但這太荒謬了
誰會如此殘忍？！

entries.label: ABOUT_ALLIANCE
entries.body:
You mean the one we helped demolish? That one?
Well, we had some contact with Alliance members before the Ur-Quan showed up.
Mostly with the Chenjesu, who stopped off here occasionally
when they were on their way to explore the galactic core.
Actually, their last visit was interesting. They were returning from the Tucanae Star systems
Where they said they had found a new alien race called the Fop-Dope-Bic...or something like that.
The only other race we ever dealt with was the Mmrnmhrm who once tried to colonize Beta Herculis
which we considered within our sphere of influence.
When we explained this to the Mmrnmhrm, they politely withdrew from the contested star system
and never bothered us again.

Actually, their last visit was interesting. They were returning from the Tucanae Star systems
Where they said they had found a new alien race called the Fop-Dope-Bic...or something like that.
The only other race we ever dealt with was the Mmrnmhrm who once tried to colonize Beta Herculis
which we considered within our sphere of influence.
When we explained this to the Mmrnmhrm, they politely withdrew from the contested star system
and never bothered us again.
entries.translation:
你是指我們協助摧毀的那個 聯盟嗎？那個？
嗯，烏爾關現身以前， 我們曾與聯盟成員有過一些 接觸。
主要是陳傑蘇， 他們前往探索銀河核心時
偶爾會在這裡停留。
其實，他們上次來訪頗有意 思。當時他們正從 Tucanae 恆星系返回
說在那裡發現一個叫做福普 －多普－比克…… 還是類似名稱的新外星種 族。
我們唯一交涉過的另一個種 族是姆爾恩姆赫姆， 他們有次試圖殖民 Beta Herculis
但我們認為該地位於自己的 勢力範圍內。
我們向姆爾恩姆赫姆說明 後，他們禮貌地退出了爭議 恆星系
再也沒有來打擾我們。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHER
entries.body:
Since we tend to stay close to home -- preferably in the living room
we know little about other races beyond our neighbors, such as the Umgah.
Before being subjugated by the Ur-Quan, the Umgah were a contented and peaceable race
who inhabited the region of stars which you call `Orionis'.
They spent their time happily exploring and mining the nearby planetary systems
and engaging in elaborate, and to our way of thinking, cruel practical jokes.
One particularly nasty prank was the time they broadcast a trick message through space
declaring the arrival of the 'Grand Master Planet Eaters' or some such nonsense.
This caused several alien cultures to go mad with panic
including, you might be surprised to know, ourselves.

entries.translation:
由於我們習慣待在家附近— —最好就待在客廳裡
所以除了烏姆加這類鄰居， 對其他種族所知甚少。
遭烏爾關征服以前， 烏姆加是個知足和平的種族
居住在你們稱為「Orio nis」的群星區域。
他們樂於探索附近的行星系 並開採礦物
還會設計繁複、 在我們看來相當殘酷的惡作 劇。
其中一次格外惡劣的惡作 劇，是他們向太空發送了一 道虛假訊息
宣告「行星吞噬大師」還是 什麼荒唐東西已經到來。
結果好幾個外星文化都陷入 瘋狂恐慌
你或許會驚訝， 其中也包括我們。

entries.label: ABOUT_PRECURSORS
entries.body:
Like all other races, we have found evidence of the Precursors scattered throughout our space.
Our belief is that the Precursors are not really gone, they simply came to their senses one day
and used their superior technology to invent some kind of perfect invisibility shield
and remain alive and happy to this day. We hope to rediscover this secret someday
and disappear into similar obscurity.
One other thing
We haven't been able to translate much of their writing, but we understand one fragment of text.
It mentions a sequence of 10 artificial `waste disposal sites' they built somewhere around here.
I suspect that even garbage from the Precursors would be of incredible value.

entries.translation:
和其他所有種族一樣， 我們也在自己的空域各處發 現了先驅者存在過的證據。
我們相信先驅者並未真正消 失，他們只是有一天恢復了 理智
運用先進科技發明某種完美 的隱形護盾
而且至今仍活得幸福快樂。 我們希望有朝一日能重新發 現這項祕密
並同樣消失得無影無蹤。
還有一件事
我們無法翻譯多少他們留下 的文字，卻看懂了其中一段 殘文。
文中提到，他們在附近某處 建造了一連串十座人工「廢 棄物處理場」。
我猜就連先驅者的垃圾也會 價值連城。

entries.label: little_mistake
entries.body: Uh... sorry about that little mistake... we thought we had gotten all of those creatures.
entries.source: Uh... sorry about that little mistake... we thought we had gotten all of those creatures.
entries.translation: 呃……很抱歉出了那個小差 錯……我們以為已經把那些 生物全部消滅了。

entries.label: BIG_MISTAKE
entries.body:
That was not a LITTLE mistake.
A LITTLE mistake is leaving the top off the eye cream or forgetting to clean your lid in the morning.
Now on the other hand, a BIG mistake might be, say
telling your friends that a certain place is safe when in fact it is crawling with hideous, hungry beasts
who want nothing more than to feast on soft, Spathi flesh!
That's a BIG mistake.

That's a BIG mistake.
entries.translation:
那才不是小差錯。
所謂小差錯，是眼霜忘了蓋 蓋子，或早上忘記清理眼 瞼。
至於所謂大差錯， 比方說就是
告訴朋友某處很安全， 結果那裡到處爬滿醜陋又飢 餓的野獸
一心只想大啖柔嫩的斯帕西 肉！
這才叫大差錯。

entries.label: bye_before_party
entries.body: We shall return after we have completed the quest.
entries.source: We shall return after we have completed the quest.
entries.translation: 完成任務後，我們會再回 來。

entries.label: QUEST_AGAIN
entries.body:
So... the hunam coward has returned.
You know, if the Ur-Quan discover we have been fraternizing with you
we're going to be in serious trouble.
Perhaps it would be better if you just leave.
Unless you're here to accept the quest, that is.
entries.source:
So... the hunam coward has returned.
You know, if the Ur-Quan discover we have been fraternizing with you
we're going to be in serious trouble.
Perhaps it would be better if you just leave.
Unless you're here to accept the quest, that is.
entries.translation:
所以……那個胡南膽小鬼回 來了。
你知道，要是烏爾關發現我 們一直和你打交道
我們就會惹上大麻煩。
也許你還是直接離開比較 好。
除非你是來接受任務的。

entries.label: GOODBYE_BEFORE_PARTY
entries.body: Unless you are killed and eaten, which is fairly likely.
entries.source: Unless you are killed and eaten, which is fairly likely.
entries.translation: 除非你被殺掉吃了； 這種可能性相當高。

entries.label: GOOD_START
entries.body:
You have made a good start and are to be commended.
Now go finish the job.
entries.source:
You have made a good start and are to be commended.
Now go finish the job.
entries.translation:
你開了個好頭，值得稱許。
現在去把工作完成。

entries.label: something_fishy
entries.body: Hey, are you up to something fishy?
entries.source: Hey, are you up to something fishy?
entries.translation: 嘿，你們是不是在搞什麼魚 腥可疑的事？

entries.label: NOTHING_FISHY
entries.body:
Fishy! Fishy? What is this fishy?
No, nothing fishy here -- totally fishless.
There, now that that's resolved
is there anything else you would like to talk about, Captain?
entries.source:
Fishy! Fishy? What is this fishy?
No, nothing fishy here -- totally fishless.
There, now that that's resolved
is there anything else you would like to talk about, Captain?
entries.translation:
魚腥！魚腥？什麼叫魚腥？
不，這裡完全不魚腥——根 本連魚都沒有。
好啦，既然這件事已經釐清
還有什麼想談的嗎，艦長？

entries.label: surrender
entries.body: We demand an immediate surrender!
entries.source: We demand an immediate surrender!
entries.translation: 我們要求你們立刻投降！

entries.label: NO_SURRENDER
entries.body:
I'm sorry, I must have an embarrassing waxy build-up in my hearing hole.
What did you say?
entries.source:
I'm sorry, I must have an embarrassing waxy build-up in my hearing hole.
What did you say?
entries.translation:
抱歉，我的聽覺孔裡大概積 了一層令人難堪的耳垢。
你剛才說什麼？

entries.label: surrender_or_die
entries.body: If you won't surrender, we must destroy you.
entries.source: If you won't surrender, we must destroy you.
entries.translation: 如果你們不投降， 我們就必須摧毀你們。

entries.label: DEFEND_OURSELVES
entries.body: There ARE other options you know, but if you insist...
entries.source: There ARE other options you know, but if you insist...
entries.translation: 你知道其實還有其他選擇， 不過既然你堅持……

entries.label: hand_in_friendship
entries.body: We offer our hand in friendship. Join us and our many allies.
entries.source: We offer our hand in friendship. Join us and our many allies.
entries.translation: 我們伸出友誼之手。 加入我們以及我們眾多的盟 友吧。

entries.label: TOO_AFRAID
entries.body:
We are too afraid of the Ur-Quan to consider such an alliance.
They would most certainly punish us with extreme tortures.
entries.source:
We are too afraid of the Ur-Quan to consider such an alliance.
They would most certainly punish us with extreme tortures.
entries.translation:
我們太害怕烏爾關， 無法考慮這種同盟。
他們肯定會以極端酷刑懲罰 我們。

entries.label: stronger
entries.body: We're stronger than the Ur-Quan. You're better off with us.
entries.source: We're stronger than the Ur-Quan. You're better off with us.
entries.translation: 我們比烏爾關更強。 加入我們對你們比較有利。

entries.label: YOURE_NOT
entries.body:
Hello! Hello! Awaken from your dreamy state Hunam!
Now is the time for realism, not wild fancy!
entries.source:
Hello! Hello! Awaken from your dreamy state Hunam!
Now is the time for realism, not wild fancy!
entries.translation:
喂！喂！從幻想中醒來吧， 胡南！
現在該面對現實， 不是胡思亂想！

entries.label: yes_we_are
entries.body: Yes we ARE strong enough! Look at our Precursor vessel. Is it not unique?
entries.source: Yes we ARE strong enough! Look at our Precursor vessel. Is it not unique?
entries.translation: 沒錯，我們就是夠強！ 看看我們的先驅者船艦。 它不是獨一無二嗎？

entries.label: NO_YOURE_NOT
entries.body:
Yes, your vessel is unique, and here is the crux of the problem.
A `Unique', meaning singular, starship is not equal to the task of destroying the entire Ur-Quan armada.
If you had, say, ten thousand similar starships, we could take your boasts more seriously.
entries.source:
Yes, your vessel is unique, and here is the crux of the problem.
A `Unique', meaning singular, starship is not equal to the task of destroying the entire Ur-Quan armada.
If you had, say, ten thousand similar starships, we could take your boasts more seriously.
entries.translation:
沒錯，你的船艦獨一無二， 而這正是問題核心。
所謂「獨一」， 也就是只有一艘， 無法完成摧毀整支烏爾關艦 隊的任務。
如果你有，比方說， 一萬艘類似星艦， 我們就能更認真看待你的誇 口。

entries.label: how_prove
entries.body: Look, what do I have to do to prove this to you - destroy your entire star fleet?
entries.source: Look, what do I have to do to prove this to you - destroy your entire star fleet?
entries.translation: 聽著，我究竟得怎麼證明— —摧毀你們整支星際艦隊 嗎？

entries.label: BETTER_IDEA
entries.body:
Well, that would probably work
but I have a better idea -- a test
one of those questy kind of things.
entries.source:
Well, that would probably work
but I have a better idea -- a test
one of those questy kind of things.
entries.translation:
嗯，那大概會有用
不過我有個更好的主意—— 一場測驗
就是那種很像冒險任務的東 西。

entries.label: share_info
entries.body: Would you be willing to share some information with us?
entries.source: Would you be willing to share some information with us?
entries.translation: 你們願意和我們分享一些情 報嗎？

entries.label: NO_INFO
entries.body: No.
entries.source: No.
entries.translation: 不願意。

entries.label: WE_UNDERSTAND
entries.body:
We understand.
That's why we live on this inhospitable moon, instead of our nice, warm home planet.
entries.source:
We understand.
That's why we live on this inhospitable moon, instead of our nice, warm home planet.
entries.translation:
我們明白。
這就是我們住在這顆環境惡 劣的衛星，而不是溫暖舒適 母星上的原因。

entries.label: prove_strength
entries.body: Ok, to prove our strength and bravery we will perform this test without even knowing what it is!
entries.source: Ok, to prove our strength and bravery we will perform this test without even knowing what it is!
entries.translation: 好，為了證明我們的力量與 勇氣，就算不知道測驗內 容，我們也照做！

entries.label: YOUR_BEHAVIOR
entries.body:
Your behavior makes clear the very slight distinction between bravery
and suicidal stupidity.
entries.source:
Your behavior makes clear the very slight distinction between bravery
and suicidal stupidity.
entries.translation:
你的行為清楚展示了勇敢
與自殺式愚蠢之間那一丁點 差別。

entries.label: what_test
entries.body: Well, what kind of test do you have in mind?
entries.source: Well, what kind of test do you have in mind?
entries.translation: 好吧，你們想要進行什麼樣 的測驗？

entries.label: BEFORE_ACCEPT
entries.body:
Let us explain the sad history of our species.
Once upon a time, many thousands of years ago
we inhabited the warm, safe surface of our home planet, Spathiwa.
We were happy and content. During those golden centuries, we evolved from a primitive nomadic culture
into a complex, agrarian society. We learned to write on clay tablets
and we were well on to being able to read those tablets
when the Darkness fell upon us
when the Evil Ones came!
Creatures from the darkest pits of hell they were.
They hunted our people -- devoured them like tasty nodules
and we had no defense against them.
Suddenly, our culture became once more nomadic.
We fled across the oceans, from continent to continent, but the evil ones always followed.
Spurred by our great need, we advanced from bronze to atomic technology in less than one of your centuries
but none of our innovations was a match for the Evil Ones' natural cunning and ferocity.
Finally, with no other option available, we fled our world and took up residence here on our own moon
where we have resided, most uncomfortably, for the last three hundred years.

entries.translation:
容我們說明本族悲慘的歷 史。
很久很久以前，在數千年前
我們居住在母星斯帕西瓦溫 暖安全的地表。
我們幸福而滿足。 在那些黃金世紀裡， 我們從原始的遊牧文化
演化成複雜的農業社會。 我們學會在泥板上書寫
而且就快要能讀懂那些泥板 時
黑暗降臨了
邪惡者來了！
他們是來自地獄最黑暗深淵 的生物。
他們獵殺我們的人民——像 美味肉球一樣吞吃
而我們毫無防衛能力。
突然之間，我們的文化再度 成了遊牧文化。
我們渡海逃亡， 從一座大陸逃到另一座， 但邪惡者總是緊追不捨。
迫於強烈需求， 我們在不到你們一個世紀的 時間內，從青銅科技進步到 原子科技
但沒有一項創新能敵過邪惡 者天生的狡猾與凶猛。
最後，在別無選擇之下， 我們逃離家園， 遷居到自己的衛星上
過去三百年來， 我們一直極不舒適地住在這 裡。

entries.label: WIPE_EVIL
entries.body: You must wipe the Evil Ones from the face of Spathiwa!
entries.source: You must wipe the Evil Ones from the face of Spathiwa!
entries.translation: 你們必須把邪惡者從斯帕西 瓦地表徹底消滅！

entries.label: think_more
entries.body: Gee, I'd like to think about this some more before making any commitments.
entries.source: Gee, I'd like to think about this some more before making any commitments.
entries.translation: 這個嘛，我想在作出任何承 諾以前再多考慮一下。

entries.label: COWARD
entries.body: Don't feel bad about being a coward. It's natural.
entries.source: Don't feel bad about being a coward. It's natural.
entries.translation: 別因為自己是膽小鬼就難 過。這很自然。

entries.label: tell_evil
entries.body: Tell me more about these Evil Ones.
entries.source: Tell me more about these Evil Ones.
entries.translation: 再多告訴我一些那些邪惡者 的事。

entries.label: i_accept
entries.body: Ok, I accept!  Start packing your bags, eyeball dudes, you'll be home in no time.
entries.source: Ok, I accept!  Start packing your bags, eyeball dudes, you'll be home in no time.
entries.translation: 好，我接受！  眼球老兄們，開始打包吧， 很快就能回家了。

entries.label: AWAIT_RETURN
entries.body:
We will await your return with great anticipation.
Simultaneously, we will prepare a short, poignant eulogy to mourn your demise.
entries.source:
We will await your return with great anticipation.
Simultaneously, we will prepare a short, poignant eulogy to mourn your demise.
entries.translation:
我們會滿懷期待地等你歸 來。
同時，我們也會準備一篇簡 短感人的悼詞， 哀悼你的死亡。

entries.label: talk_test
entries.body: Can we talk about that test again?
entries.source: Can we talk about that test again?
entries.translation: 我們能再談談那場測驗嗎？

entries.label: already_got_them
entries.body: What a coincidence! It's your lucky day -- we just eliminated all of those guys!
entries.source: What a coincidence! It's your lucky day -- we just eliminated all of those guys!
entries.translation: 真巧！今天是你們的幸運日 ——我們剛好把那些傢伙全 部消滅了！

entries.label: EARLY_BIRD_CHECK
entries.body:
What?! Can this be a true fact and not a false lie?
We will send an exploration team to investigate your claim.
If what you have said is true, we shall be forever... er
substantially in debt to you for a long, though unspecified, period of time.
Goodbye.
entries.source:
What?! Can this be a true fact and not a false lie?
We will send an exploration team to investigate your claim.
If what you have said is true, we shall be forever... er
substantially in debt to you for a long, though unspecified, period of time.
Goodbye.
entries.translation:
什麼？！這是真實事實， 而不是虛假謊言嗎？
我們會派遣探索隊調查你的 說法。
如果你所言屬實， 我們將永遠……呃
在一段很長但未明確指定的 期間內，欠你一筆相當可觀 的人情。
再見。

entries.label: NOT_SURPRISED
entries.body:
I'm not surprised. We certainly won't go there.
Why should you be any less craven than ourselves?
entries.source:
I'm not surprised. We certainly won't go there.
Why should you be any less craven than ourselves?
entries.translation:
我不意外。我們當然不會去 那裡。
你何必比我們更不怯懦？

entries.label: TEST_AGAIN
entries.body:
You must wipe the Evil Ones from the face of Spathiwa!
They are creatures from the darkest pits of hell
whose relentless passion for our fleshy parts
forced us to abandon our otherwise wonderful homeworld
and take up unhappy residence on this cold, airless moon.
entries.source:
You must wipe the Evil Ones from the face of Spathiwa!
They are creatures from the darkest pits of hell
whose relentless passion for our fleshy parts
forced us to abandon our otherwise wonderful homeworld
and take up unhappy residence on this cold, airless moon.
entries.translation:
你們必須把邪惡者從斯帕西 瓦地表徹底消滅！
他們是來自地獄最黑暗深淵 的生物
對我們肉體部位懷有永不止 息的欲望
迫使我們放棄原本美好的母 星
不情不願地住在這顆寒冷、 沒有空氣的衛星上。

entries.label: too_dangerous
entries.body: Nah, this sounds too dangerous.
entries.source: Nah, this sounds too dangerous.
entries.translation: 不了，這聽起來太危險。

entries.label: WE_AGREE
entries.body: You're right. It is. Don't even consider reconsidering.
entries.source: You're right. It is. Don't even consider reconsidering.
entries.translation: 你說得對，確實很危險。 千萬別考慮重新考慮。

entries.label: HOW_GO_EFFORTS
entries.body: How go your foolishly courageous and noble efforts to rid the Evil Ones from our beloved Spathiwa?
entries.source: How go your foolishly courageous and noble efforts to rid the Evil Ones from our beloved Spathiwa?
entries.translation: 你們愚勇又高尚地努力為我 們心愛的斯帕西瓦剷除邪惡 者，進展如何？

entries.label: killed_them_all_1
entries.body: Although we lost many crew, we have eliminated the scourge.
entries.source: Although we lost many crew, we have eliminated the scourge.
entries.translation: 雖然損失了許多船員， 但我們已消滅禍害。

entries.label: killed_them_all_2
entries.body: We killed them all, yup we sure did.
entries.source: We killed them all, yup we sure did.
entries.translation: 我們全殺光了，對， 真的全殺光了。

entries.label: WILL_CHECK_1
entries.body:
This is wonderful -- too good to be true!
We will immediately begin transporting Spathi from this unpleasant moon down to the safe surface.
We shall send encrustlings and the infirm elderly first, as a special honor!
Please come back later to receive your accolades.
entries.source:
This is wonderful -- too good to be true!
We will immediately begin transporting Spathi from this unpleasant moon down to the safe surface.
We shall send encrustlings and the infirm elderly first, as a special honor!
Please come back later to receive your accolades.
entries.translation:
太棒了——好得令人難以置 信！
我們會立刻開始把斯帕西從 這顆討厭的衛星運到安全的 地表。
我們將把幼殼仔和孱弱老人 先送過去，作為特別的榮 譽！
請稍後回來接受表揚。

entries.label: WILL_CHECK_2
entries.body:
Fool me once, shame on you.
Fool me twice, shame on...er
even MORE shame on you!
You lied to us before
but I suppose we'll check again.
entries.source:
Fool me once, shame on you.
Fool me twice, shame on...er
even MORE shame on you!
You lied to us before
but I suppose we'll check again.
entries.translation:
第一次受騙，錯在你。
第二次受騙，錯在……呃
更是你的錯！
你以前騙過我們
但我想，我們還是會再檢查 一次。

entries.label: zapped_a_few
entries.body: Well, we zapped a few of them, but some got away.
entries.source: Well, we zapped a few of them, but some got away.
entries.translation: 嗯，我們轟掉了幾隻， 但有些逃走了。

entries.label: RETURN_COMPLETE
entries.body: Return when you have completed the job.
entries.source: Return when you have completed the job.
entries.translation: 完成工作後再回來。

entries.label: MUST_DESTROY_ALL
entries.body:
You must destroy them all, and swiftly!
They breed like Shofixti, and will replenish their numbers in days.
entries.source:
You must destroy them all, and swiftly!
They breed like Shofixti, and will replenish their numbers in days.
entries.translation:
你們必須迅速消滅每一隻！
他們像索菲克斯提一樣能 生，幾天內數量就會恢復。

entries.label: no_landing
entries.body: Well to be honest, we haven't even landed there yet.
entries.source: Well to be honest, we haven't even landed there yet.
entries.translation: 老實說，我們甚至還沒在那 裡登陸。

entries.label: saw_creatures
entries.body: We landed and saw the creatures but left right away.
entries.source: We landed and saw the creatures but left right away.
entries.translation: 我們登陸後看見了那些生 物，但馬上就離開了。

entries.label: YOU_FORTUNATE
entries.body:
You are fortunate to have survived
but to complete the quest, and earn our friendship
you must annihilate them all!
entries.source:
You are fortunate to have survived
but to complete the quest, and earn our friendship
you must annihilate them all!
entries.translation:
你能活下來真是走運
但要完成任務、 贏得我們的友誼
就必須把他們全部殲滅！

entries.label: YOU_LIED_1
entries.body:
You failed us!
There were creatures all over!
They attacked the unsuspecting Spathi the second our ships unloaded and took off.
The poor encrustlings were gobbled like popcorn!
We can only conclude, that in your eagerness to return us to our world
you neglected to eliminate ALL the Evil Ones from the surface.
The job is incomplete until their presence is scoured from the surface of Spathiwa!
entries.source:
You failed us!
There were creatures all over!
They attacked the unsuspecting Spathi the second our ships unloaded and took off.
The poor encrustlings were gobbled like popcorn!
We can only conclude, that in your eagerness to return us to our world
you neglected to eliminate ALL the Evil Ones from the surface.
The job is incomplete until their presence is scoured from the surface of Spathiwa!
entries.translation:
你們害慘了我們！
到處都是那些生物！
我們的船艦才卸下乘客起 飛，他們便襲擊毫無防備的 斯帕西。
可憐的幼殼仔像爆米花一樣 被大口吞掉！
我們只能得出結論： 你們急著讓我們重返家園
卻疏忽了消滅地表上所有的 邪惡者。
直到斯帕西瓦地表再也找不 到他們的蹤影， 這項工作才算完成！

entries.label: YOU_LIED_2
entries.body:
What kind of fools do you take us for?
Your lying is pointless.
From this day forward we are enemies forever!
entries.source:
What kind of fools do you take us for?
Your lying is pointless.
From this day forward we are enemies forever!
entries.translation:
你們把我們當成哪種蠢蛋？
說謊毫無意義。
從今天起，我們永遠都是敵 人！

entries.label: bye_from_party_1
entries.body: Sure, I'd hate to spoil your party. See ya!
entries.source: Sure, I'd hate to spoil your party. See ya!
entries.translation: 好吧，我可不想掃你們的 興。回頭見！

entries.label: bye_from_party_2
entries.body: No sweat. We'll return later, when you have more time for us.
entries.source: No sweat. We'll return later, when you have more time for us.
entries.translation: 沒問題。等你們有更多時間 理我們，我們再回來。

entries.label: bye_from_party_3
entries.body: Hey, I can understand your excitement, so I'll just come back in a while.
entries.source: Hey, I can understand your excitement, so I'll just come back in a while.
entries.translation: 嘿，我能理解你們有多興 奮，所以過陣子再回來。

entries.label: GOODBYE_FROM_PARTY
entries.body: Goodbye.
entries.source: Goodbye.
entries.translation: 再見。

entries.label: MUST_PARTY_1
entries.body:
Oh joy! Oh happiness! We rejoice and make merry in celebration of our imminent return to our homeworld.
You are most heroic and helpful - thank you, thank you, thank you!
But now I must return to our festivities.
Please feel free to come back any time!
entries.source:
Oh joy! Oh happiness! We rejoice and make merry in celebration of our imminent return to our homeworld.
You are most heroic and helpful - thank you, thank you, thank you!
But now I must return to our festivities.
Please feel free to come back any time!
entries.translation:
喔，喜悅！喔，幸福！ 我們欣喜若狂， 為即將重返母星歡宴慶祝。
你最英勇、最熱心——謝 謝、謝謝、謝謝！
不過我現在得回去參加慶典 了。
隨時歡迎你再來！

entries.label: MUST_PARTY_2
entries.body:
Oh, you're back
greeaat.
Um... our celebrations are still going on, can you come back later?
entries.source:
Oh, you're back
greeaat.
Um... our celebrations are still going on, can you come back later?
entries.translation:
喔，你回來了
真——好。
呃……我們還在慶祝， 你可以晚點再來嗎？

entries.label: MUST_PARTY_3
entries.body:
Oh, hello Hunam. Your arrival is timed most poorly.
You called just when it was my turn at the Ja-ja pole
and now I have to wait in line all over again.
Do you think you could return at some point in the future?
entries.source:
Oh, hello Hunam. Your arrival is timed most poorly.
You called just when it was my turn at the Ja-ja pole
and now I have to wait in line all over again.
Do you think you could return at some point in the future?
entries.translation:
喔，你好，胡南。 你來得真不是時候。
你正好在輪到我玩 Ja-ja 柱時打來
現在我又得重新排一次隊 了。
你能不能改天再來？

entries.label: deals_a_deal
entries.body: Hey! A deal's a deal! What about our alliance?
entries.source: Hey! A deal's a deal! What about our alliance?
entries.translation: 嘿！交易就是交易！ 我們的同盟呢？

entries.label: WAIT_A_WHILE
entries.body:
Why don't you just wait a while, until after we are resettled on our homeworld?
We can discuss details at that time.
entries.source:
Why don't you just wait a while, until after we are resettled on our homeworld?
We can discuss details at that time.
entries.translation:
何不等一陣子， 讓我們先在母星安頓下來？
到時再討論細節。

entries.label: how_long
entries.body: How long do you expect this to take?
entries.source: How long do you expect this to take?
entries.translation: 你覺得這要花多久？

entries.label: TEN_YEARS
entries.body: Ten, fifteen years tops.
entries.source: Ten, fifteen years tops.
entries.translation: 十年、十五年，最多了。

entries.label: reneging
entries.body: Am I correct in understanding that you refuse to live up to your end of the bargain?
entries.source: Am I correct in understanding that you refuse to live up to your end of the bargain?
entries.translation: 所以我的理解沒錯： 你們拒絕履行交易中自己那 一部分？

entries.label: ADULT_VIEW
entries.body:
No, no, no!
We are simply taking a more adult, `welcome to the real world' view of the situation.
We cannot simply say, `Hurrah!' and form an alliance with you this very moment.
Surely you see that?
entries.source:
No, no, no!
We are simply taking a more adult, `welcome to the real world' view of the situation.
We cannot simply say, `Hurrah!' and form an alliance with you this very moment.
Surely you see that?
entries.translation:
不、不、不！
我們只是用更成熟、 更「歡迎來到現實世界」的 眼光看待情勢。
我們不能喊聲「萬歲！」， 就在此刻立刻與你締結同 盟。
這點你一定明白吧？

entries.label: return_beasts
entries.body: You know, those creatures aren't dead. We have them in suspended animation.  How would you like us to return them to the surface?
entries.source: You know, those creatures aren't dead. We have them in suspended animation.  How would you like us to return them to the surface?
entries.translation: 你知道嗎，那些生物還沒 死。我們只是讓他們處於假 死狀態。  想不想讓我們把他們放回地 表？

entries.label: WHAT_RELATIONSHIP
entries.body:
NO!... er,... no... please!
(sigh)
exactly what kind of relationship were you thinking of?
entries.source:
NO!... er,... no... please!
(sigh)
exactly what kind of relationship were you thinking of?
entries.translation:
不！……呃……不要…… 拜託！
（嘆氣）
你們究竟想建立哪種關係？

entries.label: minds_and_might
entries.body: A mutually beneficial alliance of minds and might.
entries.source: A mutually beneficial alliance of minds and might.
entries.translation: 思想與武力互惠互利的同 盟。

entries.label: HUH
entries.body: Huh?
entries.source: Huh?
entries.translation: 蛤？

entries.label: fellowship
entries.body: An egalitarian fellowship of sentient lifeforms.
entries.source: An egalitarian fellowship of sentient lifeforms.
entries.translation: 智慧生命形式之間平等互助 的聯誼。

entries.label: WHAT
entries.body: What?
entries.source: What?
entries.translation: 什麼？

entries.label: do_as_we_say
entries.body: The kind where you do everything EXACTLY as we say.
entries.source: The kind where you do everything EXACTLY as we say.
entries.translation: 就是你們完全照我們說的 做。

entries.label: DEPART_FOR_EARTH
entries.body:
Oh, ok... we're quite familiar with that arrangement.
Very well... I'll bet we will regret this decision later on, but you leave me with no choice.
We will comply with your needs.
A Spathi delegation will depart immediately for the planet Earth.
entries.source:
Oh, ok... we're quite familiar with that arrangement.
Very well... I'll bet we will regret this decision later on, but you leave me with no choice.
We will comply with your needs.
A Spathi delegation will depart immediately for the planet Earth.
entries.translation:
喔，好吧……我們對這種安 排很熟悉。
很好……我敢說日後一定會 後悔這項決定， 但你們讓我別無選擇。
我們會配合你們的需要。
斯帕西代表團將立刻出發前 往地球。

entries.label: HELLO_ALLIES_1
entries.body:
Welcome back to Spathiwa, Captain.
We hope the material we provided your starbase engineers was sufficient for your needs.
entries.source:
Welcome back to Spathiwa, Captain.
We hope the material we provided your starbase engineers was sufficient for your needs.
entries.translation:
歡迎回到斯帕西瓦，艦長。
希望我們提供給你星際基地 工程師的材料足以滿足需 求。

entries.label: HELLO_ALLIES_2
entries.body: What can we, the High Spathi Ruling Council, do for you?
entries.source: What can we, the High Spathi Ruling Council, do for you?
entries.translation: 我們斯帕西最高統治議會能 為你做些什麼？

entries.label: HELLO_ALLIES_3
entries.body: Hello Captain, what brings you here today?
entries.source: Hello Captain, what brings you here today?
entries.translation: 你好，艦長，今天是什麼風 把你吹來？

entries.label: whats_up
entries.body: Have there been any developments of significance?
entries.source: Have there been any developments of significance?
entries.translation: 有任何重大進展嗎？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_1
entries.body:
Perhaps Captain. I will explain.
We have been investigating the `Caster which we took away from the Umgah
after the `Jud the Vug' scandal, 8 years ago.
We have uncovered evidence of something strange going on between the Umgah and the Ilwrath over the past many years.
We suspect that the Umgah were using the `Caster to pull off some kind of long-term joke on the Ilwrath
but we are unable to glean any more details.

entries.translation:
或許有，艦長。我來說明。
我們一直在研究八年前「J ud the Vug」醜聞發生後
從烏姆加手中取走的超波發 射器。
我們發現證據， 顯示烏姆加與伊爾拉斯之間 多年來發生著一些怪事。
我們懷疑烏姆加一直用發射 器對伊爾拉斯進行某種長期 惡作劇
但無法查出更多細節。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_2
entries.body:
Yes, and the news is not good.
As you know, Androsynth space borders our own, and while we never really liked the Androsynth
it seemed that they weren't out to kill us as everyone else seems to be.
Imagine our shock when we learned that they had been invaded and eaten by those fish-folk, the Orz!
Well actually we don't know if the Orz ate anybody, but we're sure they did something creepy.
I sure hope you're not considering an alliance with them, Captain, they are dangerous.

entries.translation:
有，而且不是好消息。
你也知道，安德羅辛斯空域 與我們接壤；雖然我們從來 不怎麼喜歡安德羅辛斯
但他們似乎不像其他所有種 族一樣想殺掉我們。
想像一下，我們得知他們遭 到那些魚人奧茲入侵並吃掉 時有多震驚！
其實我們並不知道奧茲是否 吃了任何人，不過他們肯定 做了某種詭異的事。
艦長，希望你沒有在考慮和 他們結盟，他們很危險。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_3
entries.body:
I guess we forgot to tell you this a while ago... sorry
but we've been so busy lately, working on the shie-- er... preparations for returning to Spathiwa
that I'm afraid it just slipped my mind.
Okay, that's all.
Hey, I gave you an apology!
What more do you want?
Oh, right! The thing I forgot.
Yes, I remember now! It was something odd that happened to us when we first met the Ur-Quan.
We sent out a ship to meet the oncoming Dreadnoughts
we wanted to tell the Ur-Quan about the Evil Ones, so they could safely avoid our planet
but when we got close, the Ur-Quan started blasting out this overwhelming signal
`SENTIENT LIFE.  WE ARE THE UR-QUAN. INDEPENDENCE IS INTOLERABLE. BLAH, BLAH, BLAH.' -- you get the idea
anyway, in a moment of panicked genius, the Captain blurted out
`Hold! What you are doing to us is wrong! Why do you do this thing?'
To everyone's amazement, the Ur-Quan fleet stopped dead in space.
The Ur-Quan fixed a tight communication beam on the ship
and the creature spoke a long while and with great passion
almost as though it were intoning a high ritual.
The words he spoke were of planet-shaking significance!
At least, we assume so. We can't be really sure, because all of the Spathi on board at the time
were curled tightly in their shellcases, and couldn't hear very well.
Maybe if you get the opportunity Captain, you can try to ask the question again.

entries.translation:
我想我們之前忘了告訴你這 件事……抱歉
但最近忙著進行護—— 呃……重返斯帕西瓦的準備 工作
恐怕一不小心就忘了。
好，說完了。
嘿，我已經道歉了！
你還想要什麼？
喔，對了！我忘記的那件 事。
沒錯，我想起來了！ 那是我們初次遇見烏爾關時 發生的一件怪事。
我們派出一艘船迎接駛來的 無畏艦
想把邪惡者的事告訴烏爾 關，讓他們能安全避開我們 的行星
但我們一靠近， 烏爾關就開始發出一道壓倒 性訊號
「智慧生命。我們是烏爾 關。獨立不可容忍。囉嗦、 囉嗦、囉嗦。」——你明白 意思了
總之，艦長在驚慌中靈光一 閃，脫口而出
「住手！你們這樣對待我們 是不對的！為什麼要這麼 做？」
令所有人驚訝的是， 烏爾關艦隊立刻停在太空 中。
烏爾關把一道緊密的通訊波 束對準船艦
那生物滿懷激情地講了很久
幾乎就像在吟誦某種崇高儀 式。
他所說的話，重要到足以震 撼行星！
至少我們是這麼猜的。 其實無法確定， 因為當時船上的所有斯帕西
都緊緊蜷縮在自己的殼囊 裡，根本聽不清楚。
艦長，如果有機會， 也許你可以再問一次那個問 題。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_4
entries.body:
Developments?! What developments!? Whatever are you talking about, Captain?
Are you implying we are up to something -- that we have some kind of secret plan!?
How wrong you are, Captain! Our feelings are injured by your unwarranted accusation.
Apologies would be appropriate at this time.

entries.translation:
進展？！什麼進展！？ 你究竟在說什麼，艦長？
你是在暗示我們正暗中做些 什麼——有某種祕密計畫 嗎！？
錯得離譜，艦長！ 你無端指控，傷害了我們的 感情。
現在正是你道歉的適當時 機。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_5
entries.body: No Captain, no news.
entries.source: No Captain, no news.
entries.translation: 沒有，艦長，沒有消息。

entries.label: like_some_info
entries.body: Would you supply us with certain specific bits of information?
entries.source: Would you supply us with certain specific bits of information?
entries.translation: 你願意提供幾項特定資訊 嗎？

entries.label: WHAT_ABOUT
entries.body: Certainly, about what?
entries.source: Certainly, about what?
entries.translation: 當然，關於什麼？
